item.stringtheory.string_shard.lore: It hums when no one is listening.
item.stringtheory.tuning_fork.lore: Strike it, and something answers from far away.
block.stringtheory.calabi_stone.lore: Six dimensions, folded into the size of a fist.
block.stringtheory.resonator.lore: It is not a machine. It is an ear.
item.stringtheory.tuned_string_1.lore: Open. It searches for an end that is not there.
item.stringtheory.tuned_string_2.lore: Closed, like an echo with no source.
item.stringtheory.tuned_string_3.lore: Its mirror image sounds in another world.
item.stringtheory.tuned_string_4.lore: The left half sings one song, the right another.
gui.stringtheory.fork.tip: Requires a Tuning Fork in your inventory
